The harness uses KPI Parity Validator. ## Internal Relationships All internal calls are in-process. The replay command starts or resumes one simulated day and starts acceptance only after terminal product state. ## External Relationships The container reads the DIDRAH Input Dataset, calls the Backend API over authenticated HTTPS/JSON, and stores acceptance results in PostgreSQL. ## Component Sections ### Replay Command - **DSL identifier:** `replayCommandV2`; **Display name:** Replay Command. - **Purpose:** Sequence a replay range and resume from the last terminal day. **Responsibilities:** Load range, pin time and profile, submit scripted input, start runs, and start terminal checks. **Inputs:** Versioned replay range and evaluator command. **Outputs:** Ordered simulated-day execution and final replay status. - **Owned state:** Replay progress in persisted product and acceptance records. **Dependencies:** Simulation Clock, Evaluation Profile Loader, Run Status Client, Scripted Manager Input Adapter, and Acceptance Test Harness. **Security boundary:** Only versioned evaluation input is accepted. **Forbidden responsibilities:** Run product stages or use host time as product time. - **Failure behavior:** Stop at the failed day and preserve the resume point. **Idempotency:** Replay range and day key make resume safe. **Observability:** Record range, day, run ID, status, and trace ID. **Related ADRs:** ADR-0011, ADR-0012, ADR-0018. **Open issues:** Scheduler process type remains open. ### Simulation Clock - **DSL identifier:** `simulationClockV2`; **Display name:** Simulation Clock. - **Purpose:** Derive the pinned business date and source cutoff. **Responsibilities:** Resolve evaluation day semantics without host-clock dependence. **Inputs:** Replay day and evaluation calendar rules. **Outputs:** Business date and source cutoff. - **Owned state:** None. **Dependencies:** Replay Command. **Security boundary:** Pinned evaluation input is authoritative. **Forbidden responsibilities:** Read product state or advance time by wall clock. - **Failure behavior:** Reject an invalid or ambiguous day. **Idempotency:** Same day and rules give the same result. **Observability:** Record input day, derived cutoff, rule version, and trace ID. **Related ADRs:** ADR-0011, ADR-0012. **Open issues:** None. ### Evaluation Profile Loader - **DSL identifier:** `evaluationProfileLoaderV2`; **Display name:** Evaluation Profile Loader. - **Purpose:** Load selected evaluation limits, thresholds, and run options. **Responsibilities:** Validate and supply one versioned profile. **Inputs:** Profile identifier and versioned evaluation data. **Outputs:** Validated evaluation profile or rejection. - **Owned state:** None. **Dependencies:** DIDRAH Input Dataset. **Security boundary:** Profile values do not change product architecture decisions. **Forbidden responsibilities:** Invent missing thresholds or change product configuration. - **Failure behavior:** Stop the command when the profile is missing or invalid. **Idempotency:** Profile ID and version identify one result. **Observability:** Record profile version, validation result, and trace ID. **Related ADRs:** ADR-0011, ADR-0012, ADR-0016. **Open issues:** None. ### Run Status Client - **DSL identifier:** `runStatusClientV2`; **Display name:** Run Status Client. - **Purpose:** Start and monitor runs through the Backend Run Coordinator. **Responsibilities:** Send authenticated start and status requests and wait for terminal state. **Inputs:** Pinned day, run options, identity, and existing run ID. **Outputs:** Run ID and authorized run status. - **Owned state:** None. **Dependencies:** Backend Run Coordinator. **Security boundary:** It uses the product API and does not access PostgreSQL directly. **Forbidden responsibilities:** Create stage jobs or infer terminal state locally. - **Failure behavior:** Preserve the run ID and allow a later status retry. **Idempotency:** Start key prevents duplicate run creation. **Observability:** Record request, run ID, status, latency, and trace ID. **Related ADRs:** ADR-0011, ADR-0018. **Open issues:** None. ### Acceptance Test Harness - **DSL identifier:** `acceptanceTestHarnessV2`; **Display name:** Acceptance Test Harness. - **Purpose:** Run replay, regression, leakage, performance, contract, and parity checks. **Responsibilities:** Load limits, verify terminal state, run suites, and store receipts. **Inputs:** Terminal run, evaluation profile, reference contracts, and reference SQLite assets. **Outputs:** Acceptance results and receipts. - **Owned state:** Acceptance results in PostgreSQL; temporary SQLite is inside the harness only. **Dependencies:** Evaluation Profile Loader, Run Status Client, PostgreSQL, and KPI Parity Validator. **Security boundary:** Reference files are read-only. **Forbidden responsibilities:** Act as product runtime or publish product output. - **Failure behavior:** Record failed checks with evidence and keep product state unchanged. **Idempotency:** Run ID, suite version, and profile version identify the result. **Observability:** Record suite, check, result, duration, receipt, and trace ID. **Related ADRs:** ADR-0002, ADR-0011, ADR-0012, ADR-0016. **Open issues:** Performance thresholds come from the selected profile. ### KPI Parity Validator - **DSL identifier:** `kpiParityValidator`; **Display name:** KPI Parity Validator. - **Purpose:** Compare 55 SQLite reference results with PostgreSQL results. **Responsibilities:** Run read-only reference SQL in the harness, compare values under approved tolerances, and store receipts. **Inputs:** Reference SQLite data and SQL, PostgreSQL results, and tolerance profile. **Outputs:** Per-KPI parity results and Parity Receipt. - **Owned state:** Parity Receipts in PostgreSQL; temporary SQLite state stays in the harness. **Dependencies:** Acceptance Test Harness and PostgreSQL results. **Security boundary:** Reference SQL and data are read-only. **Forbidden responsibilities:** Use SQLite in product runtime or change reference SQL. - **Failure behavior:** Mark parity failure with exact KPI evidence. **Idempotency:** Dataset, SQL, result, and validator versions identify one comparison. **Observability:** Record KPI, versions, difference, tolerance, result, and trace ID. **Related ADRs:** ADR-0002, ADR-0011, ADR-0016. **Open issues:** None. ### Scripted Manager Input Adapter - **DSL identifier:** `scriptedManagerInputAdapter`; **Display name:** Scripted Manager Input Adapter. - **Purpose:** Submit versioned replay inputs through the same Backend API as interactive input. **Responsibilities:** Read pinned manager input, create an authenticated product request, and preserve order and identity. **Inputs:** Versioned scripted manager input and replay day. **Outputs:** Backend API request and accepted result or job ID. - **Owned state:** None. **Dependencies:** DIDRAH Input Dataset and Backend API. **Security boundary:** Scripts do not bypass authentication, authorization, or validation. **Forbidden responsibilities:** Write product state directly or call internal Backend components. - **Failure behavior:** Record the rejected input and stop or continue under the evaluation profile. **Idempotency:** Script event ID and replay day prevent duplicate submission. **Observability:** Record event ID, request type, result, job ID, and trace ID. **Related ADRs:** ADR-0010, ADR-0011, ADR-0012, ADR-0018. **Open issues:** None. ## Container-level Open Issues - The final .NET Console or Worker Service choice remains open in ADR-0018.

# Agent Runtime components ## Purpose and Scope The Agent Runtime claims durable Agent Jobs from PostgreSQL and runs bounded LangGraph graphs. It produces structured candidates only. It does not own product truth. ## Runtime Technology Python 3.12, LangGraph, Pydantic, and a PostgreSQL driver that remains an open decision. ## Trust Boundary The Runtime has limited database access to Agent Job, Lease, Attempt, Checkpoint, Conversation, Candidate, and job-scoped Evidence views. It gets business evidence through Backend services. ## Allowed Responsibilities - Claim leased Agent Jobs and persist candidate or terminal failure state. - Run bounded report, interactive, or document decision-card graphs. - Apply model limits and store resumable checkpoints and scoped conversation turns. ## Forbidden Responsibilities - Run arbitrary SQL against business tables. - Calculate KPIs, change policy, run migrations, publish results, or confirm decisions. - Treat wake-ups as durable jobs. ## Component Map Agent Job Runner claims work and invokes Bounded Agent Orchestrator. The orchestrator uses Conversation Service and Model Gateway. PostgreSQL Checkpoint Store supports resume. ## Internal Relationships The Runner invokes one bounded graph. The graph uses the model through Model Gateway and persists checkpoints and turns through deterministic components. ## External Relationships The Runtime claims from PostgreSQL, gets evidence and validation from the Backend API, calls the Language Model Provider, and can send redacted telemetry to the optional Collector. ## Component Sections ### Bounded Agent Orchestrator - **DSL identifier:** `agentOrchestrator`; **Display name:** Bounded Agent Orchestrator. - **Purpose:** Coordinate one bounded report, interactive, or decision-card graph. **Responsibilities:** Load authorized evidence, manage bounded steps, use conversation context, request model work, and return structured candidates. **Inputs:** Claimed job, scope, evidence references, and graph configuration. **Outputs:** Structured candidate or terminal graph failure. - **Owned state:** Graph state through PostgreSQL checkpoints. **Dependencies:** Evidence Service, Conversation Service, Model Gateway, and Checkpoint Store. **Security boundary:** Job scope and evidence references bound every graph. **Forbidden responsibilities:** Direct business SQL, KPI calculation, publication, or decision confirmation. - **Failure behavior:** Persist a bounded failure and resumable checkpoint where allowed. **Idempotency:** Job attempt and checkpoint state control replay. **Observability:** Record graph, node, job, attempt, model calls, and trace ID with redaction. **Related ADRs:** ADR-0005, ADR-0008, ADR-0019, ADR-0020. **Open issues:** LangGraph node boundaries remain open. ### Agent Job Runner - **DSL identifier:** `agentJobRunner`; **Display name:** Agent Job Runner. - **Purpose:** Claim leased jobs and persist a candidate or terminal failure. **Responsibilities:** Poll or accept a hint, claim a job, invoke the graph, validate the persisted outcome through Backend, and settle the attempt. **Inputs:** PostgreSQL Ready job or authenticated job-ID wake-up. **Outputs:** Persisted candidate, terminal failure, attempt, and validation request. - **Owned state:** Job lease, attempt, and candidate state in PostgreSQL. **Dependencies:** PostgreSQL, Bounded Agent Orchestrator, and Backend Output Validator. **Security boundary:** A wake-up is a hint and grants no scope. **Forbidden responsibilities:** Execute an unclaimed job, carry evidence in a wake-up, or publish. - **Failure behavior:** Persist attempt failure and allow lease recovery under policy. **Idempotency:** Claim and lease rules prevent concurrent execution. **Observability:** Record job, lease, attempt, outcome, and linked trace context. **Related ADRs:** ADR-0008, ADR-0011, ADR-0019, ADR-0020. **Open issues:** Deadline, retry count, dead-letter policy, and reconciliation cadence remain open. ### Conversation Service - **DSL identifier:** `conversationService`; **Display name:** Conversation Service. - **Purpose:** Store manager-scoped sessions and validated turns. **Responsibilities:** Append validated turns and return a bounded authorized history window. **Inputs:** Manager scope, session ID, validated turn, and history limit. **Outputs:** Stored turn receipt and bounded history. - **Owned state:** Conversation sessions and turns in PostgreSQL. **Dependencies:** PostgreSQL. **Security boundary:** Sessions are manager-scoped and contain only validated content. **Forbidden responsibilities:** Treat chat as business evidence or cross manager scope. - **Failure behavior:** Return explicit storage or scope failure and omit unvalidated turns. **Idempotency:** Turn ID prevents duplicate append. **Observability:** Record session, turn ID, result, window size, and trace ID without full content. **Related ADRs:** ADR-0005, ADR-0008, ADR-0011, ADR-0019. **Open issues:** Retention remains open. ### Model Gateway - **DSL identifier:** `agentModelGateway`; **Display name:** Model Gateway. - **Purpose:** Apply token, time, retry, and cost limits to every model call. **Responsibilities:** Reserve budget, redact and send bounded input, call the provider, settle cost, and return completion or failure. **Inputs:** Authorized prompt, evidence subset, model policy, and budget. **Outputs:** Completion metadata and content or explicit failure. - **Owned state:** Cost reservation and settlement metadata in PostgreSQL. **Dependencies:** PostgreSQL and Language Model Provider. **Security boundary:** Do not send secrets, full documents, or unauthorized business context. **Forbidden responsibilities:** Select unapproved scope, bypass limits, or treat a completion as validated product output. - **Failure behavior:** Return bounded timeout, budget, provider, or validation failure. **Idempotency:** Call ID and reservation state prevent duplicate settlement. **Observability:** Record model metadata, tokens, cost, latency, status, and trace ID with redaction. **Related ADRs:** ADR-0008, ADR-0019, ADR-0020. **Open issues:** Provider, model, timeout, and retry count remain open. ### PostgreSQL Checkpoint Store - **DSL identifier:** `checkpointStore`; **Display name:** PostgreSQL Checkpoint Store. - **Purpose:** Store LangGraph checkpoints for resume and idempotency. **Responsibilities:** Read and write job-scoped checkpoint versions. **Inputs:** Job ID, graph version, checkpoint key, and state. **Outputs:** Stored checkpoint receipt or authorized checkpoint state. - **Owned state:** Agent checkpoints in PostgreSQL. **Dependencies:** PostgreSQL. **Security boundary:** Access is limited to the claimed job and approved checkpoint schema. **Forbidden responsibilities:** Store unrestricted business data or read another job scope. - **Failure behavior:** Fail the graph step and preserve the last complete checkpoint. **Idempotency:** Job, graph, and checkpoint version control writes. **Observability:** Record job, checkpoint key, version, result, and trace ID without full state. **Related ADRs:** ADR-0008, ADR-0011, ADR-0019. **Open issues:** Python PostgreSQL driver remains open. ## Container-level Open Issues - Python PostgreSQL driver, model/provider, model timeout, Agent Job deadline, retry count, dead-letter policy, reconciliation cadence, fallback content, and LangGraph node boundaries remain open.

# Stores and contracts ## Purpose and Scope This document defines the two product stores and two external contracts that appear in the model. These elements are not Product Components. ## Runtime Technology PostgreSQL 18, a protected mounted filesystem or compatible object storage, versioned input CSV/JSON, and a writable `OUTPUT_DIR` filesystem. ## Trust Boundary Each store or contract has a fixed authority, access mode, and mutability rule. Reference output schemas and evaluation input contracts are read-only for architecture work. ## Allowed Responsibilities - Persist product state and protected source bytes. - Supply versioned evaluation input. - Receive only validated output-contract files. ## Forbidden Responsibilities - Treat a store or contract as a Component. - Add a new store or claim a schema that the formal contracts do not define. - Use SQLite as a product store. ## Component Map | DSL identifier | Element | Kind | |---|---|---| | `postgres` | PostgreSQL | Product store | | `fileArchive` | Protected File Archive | Product store | | `inputDataset` | DIDRAH Input Dataset | External input contract | | `submissionOutput` | Submission Output Directory | External output contract | ## Internal Relationships PostgreSQL and Protected File Archive are inside the DIDRAH boundary. They do not call other elements. ## External Relationships The DIDRAH Input Dataset is read-only. The Submission Output Directory accepts approved brief and QA artifacts from Submission Exporter only. ## Component Sections ### PostgreSQL product database - **DSL identifier:** `postgres`; **Display name:** PostgreSQL. - **Purpose:** Be the only product database and source of truth for durable state. **Responsibilities:** Store product, analytical, access, job, checkpoint, receipt, and audit records. **Inputs:** Authorized product writes and approved queries. **Outputs:** Scoped records, projections, job state, and receipts. - **Owned state:** Product state in proposed versioned schemas. **Dependencies:** PostgreSQL 18 runtime and controlled migrations. **Security boundary:** Roles, grants, views, RLS, and purpose checks limit access. **Forbidden responsibilities:** Store full telemetry or act as unrestricted Runtime business access. - **Failure behavior:** Product operations fail explicitly and recover from durable state. **Idempotency:** Keys, versions, leases, and receipts control retries. **Observability:** Record database health and correlation metadata, not full telemetry. **Related ADRs:** ADR-0002, ADR-0005, ADR-0011, ADR-0018, ADR-0019. **Open issues:** Runtime role names, retention, backup frequency, RPO, and RTO remain open. ### Protected File Archive - **DSL identifier:** `fileArchive`; **Display name:** Protected File Archive. - **Purpose:** Preserve original source and upload bytes with hashes and manifests. **Responsibilities:** Store immutable bytes and return controlled references. **Inputs:** Approved source or upload bytes and metadata. **Outputs:** Archive reference and read-only bytes for approved consumers. - **Owned state:** Immutable source and upload objects, hashes, and manifests. **Dependencies:** Protected mounted filesystem or compatible object storage. **Security boundary:** Access is restricted and references do not grant broad listing. **Forbidden responsibilities:** Act as a query database, execute content, or overwrite history. - **Failure behavior:** Reject partial writes and return explicit read or integrity failure. **Idempotency:** Content hash and source identity prevent duplication. **Observability:** Record object reference, hash, size, action, result, and trace ID. **Related ADRs:** ADR-0001, ADR-0010, ADR-0011, ADR-0018. **Open issues:** Retention, backup frequency, RPO, and RTO remain open. ### Input Dataset Contract - **DSL identifier:** `inputDataset`; **Display name:** DIDRAH Input Dataset. - **Purpose:** Supply versioned source, replay, upload, configuration, and history data. **Responsibilities:** Define evaluation input files and versions. **Inputs:** Formal evaluation dataset contents. **Outputs:** Read-only CSV and JSON files for ingestion, replay, and acceptance. - **Owned state:** External versioned evaluation data. **Dependencies:** Formal dataset and machine-readable contracts. **Security boundary:** Product containers mount input read-only. **Forbidden responsibilities:** Accept product writes or become product truth after ingestion. - **Failure behavior:** Missing or invalid input produces explicit ingestion or evaluation failure. **Idempotency:** Dataset version and file hashes identify the input. **Observability:** Record version, file hash, read result, and trace ID. **Related ADRs:** ADR-0001, ADR-0002, ADR-0011, ADR-0012. **Open issues:** None. ### Submission Output Contract - **DSL identifier:** `submissionOutput`; **Display name:** Submission Output Directory. - **Purpose:** Receive approved brief and QA files under `OUTPUT_DIR`. **Responsibilities:** Provide the writable evaluator mount for formal output paths. **Inputs:** Validated contract files from Submission Exporter. **Outputs:** `/briefs/day_XXX/.json` and `/qa/.json` below `OUTPUT_DIR`. - **Owned state:** External output files and their filesystem metadata. **Dependencies:** Read-only formal schemas and writable evaluator output mount. **Security boundary:** Only resolved contained paths and approved schemas can be written. **Forbidden responsibilities:** Accept internal fields, partial files, or `OUTPUT_DIR/submission/...` paths. - **Failure behavior:** Export fails without a partial final file and stores an Export Receipt failure. **Idempotency:** Relative path, version, and content hash control replacement. **Observability:** Record relative path, hash, receipt, result, and trace ID. **Related ADRs:** ADR-0011, ADR-0013, ADR-0015. **Open issues:** None. ## Container-level Open Issues - Retention, backup frequency, RPO, and RTO remain open. - No new value is set for any open decision in this document.
